tasks.source: JetBlue's whole network from 04:00 Eastern on real storm dates at JFK and Boston from December 2022 to July 2026, pack b6-v2: the flights, tails and delays from BTS on-time data, aircraft from Form 41 B-43 and the FAA registry, the FAA Command Center's ground stops and ground delay programs as issued; pilots under FAR 117 and flight attendants under 14 CFR 121.467 on trips generated from the published schedule, with reserves at the middle of a sourced industry band
tasks.selection: per storm hub 12 dates (8 summer, 4 winter), each from its own storm event, drawn with seed 0 from the storm dates (the FAA's programs at JFK or Boston controlled or held at least 5 JetBlue flights) that passed the crew model's filter, fixed before the run: JetBlue's real day crewed by the generated trips leaves at most 1% of its flown flights without a legal crew, and crews add at most 2% to its calm day (100 of 180 storm dates kept); the 44 training dates are every kept date of an event with no eval date

grading.reference: the best plan of aircraft and crews together a solver found knowing the whole day, replayed exactly with a legal crew on every flight; not a proven optimum. Its proven lower bound closes on no eval date (gap 2.4% to 13.9%, median 5.1%), most of it the bound's weakness rather than distance to the optimum
grading.reward: 0.2 + 0.8 exp(-g/0.5), g = max(0, cost - best) / max(B0 - best, 0.1 best), B0 being standard crew-desk practice with the aircraft doing nothing; cost in passenger-minutes: arrival delay, cancelled passengers (more when decided under 2 hours ahead), the FAA's aircraft rates, the night's ferries, crew deadheads, hotels and crews out of place for tomorrow; reward_L is the same against the bound; a day is scored only if its audit passes (news on time, turns, causality, roles, a legal crew on every flight, the cost not under the bound, both desks present); turns: each desk of two gets 6 a watch plus 10 (up to 232), one agent at both desks 8 a watch plus 10 (up to 306); the tools are the two desks' 19, of which one agent sees 14
grading.excused: nothing: every cost of the day is charged; a day that comes in under the best plan, which is not a proven optimum, scores 1.0 and is flagged (2023-07-13, two desks), with reward_L, against the bound, beside it

baselines.name: B0: standard crew-desk practice, the aircraft doing nothing
idle: the crew system alone, nobody at the desks
scripted desks: the crew desk forwarding its system's words, ops accepting its cancellations
the airline: JetBlue's own decisions, replayed with the generated crews

models.model: GPT-6.1 Sol, one agent at both desks
